create_InferenceBasedLoader: create an InferenceBasedLoader with a model, data loader, and optional data sampler for inference-based data generation
use_ScoreBasedFilter: use a ScoreBasedFilter to discard model output instances with scores below a specified minimum threshold
iterate_InferenceBasedLoader: iterate over an InferenceBasedLoader to yield batches of sampled annotation data from model inference results
use_grouper: use the grouper function to chunk an iterable into fixed-size tuples with optional fill values
configure_InferenceBasedLoader_shuffle: configure an InferenceBasedLoader with shuffle, batch size, and drop last options for controlled data batching
